title: Disputes
description: Review and resolve disputes between customers and providers.

help.title: About Disputes
help.overview: A dispute is an admin-moderated conflict on a marketplace order. While it is open or under review, escrow outcomes are decided when the dispute is resolved or closed — not by casual status edits.

sections.title: Statuses
items: Open — newly raised; waiting for admin intake.
Under review — an admin has started formal review.
Resolved — decided for the provider path: order can complete and remaining escrow is released.
Closed — ended without that resolve path; remaining escrow is refunded per close rules.

sections.title: Admin actions
items: Start review — only from open; moves to under review.
Resolve — from open or under review; requires a resolution note; may complete the order and release remaining escrow.
Close — from open or under review; refunds remaining escrow according to close handling.
Customer and provider are notified when the dispute ends.
sections.body: Start review, resolve, and close require an admin. Soft-deleted disputes are not actionable.

sections.title: On this page
items: Create raises a dispute against an order that has an issue.
Use sheet or row actions for review, resolve, and close.
Soft delete and restore follow the usual list permissions.
